text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 301 units of labetalol hydrochloride 100 mg tablets at 11.4 units per day (26 days supply). Corvale General holds 297 units at 13.8 units per day (22 days supply). The drug is not on the FDA shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies Heritage Pharma Labs Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Labs Inc. (FEI 3005139373) as the manufacturing plant for NDC 23155072305. FDA records show that plant received Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classifications after inspections ending 2009-07-14, 2013-11-21, 2014-01-08, 2015-04-16, 2017-04-20, and 2018-02-06. The most recent inspection on file ended 2018-02-06 with a VAI classification.

Our position: Current inventory provides less than one month of supply at both campuses. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs. Alternative suppliers are available but their labels do not identify manufacturing plants, limiting supply chain assessment.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to qualify and purchase from A-S Medication Solutions, Advagen Pharma Ltd, American Health Packaging, Biocon Pharma Inc., and BluePoint Laboratories to diversify sources; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to request manufacturing site disclosures from each alternative supplier before committing to large orders; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily and enroll in allocation programs if listing occurs; requires buyer approval.
4. Pharmacy director to review therapeutic alternatives with P&T committee for potential formulary adjustments; requires pharmacy director and P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until stock reaches critical levels. Initiating clinical protocol changes without P&T committee review.
